Advice on quiet corners for customers
What you should know comes first
Traveling With Pets at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps keep pet trips calm and orderly from booking through pickup. We work with travelers to reduce stress, set expectations, and make sure each animal is handled with care at the skyport and onboard.

For rabbits, a fresh health certificate is part of the usual file, and our team checks that the paperwork matches the booking before travel day. <<FACT F082>> Please keep copies ready in case the airport team asks for them, and bring any other documents that support the animal's safe travel.

For cats, the booking record should show the right service details before arrival, and the handling notes should be easy for staff to follow. <<FACT F055>> If you are bringing a carrier, make sure it is secure, clean, and easy to open for inspection. A quiet, steady approach helps the animal settle better when boarding starts.

We also ask customers to stay in close touch if plans change, since prompt updates help the team keep the trip smooth. If your pet has special care needs, share them early so the senior coordinator can plan the right support. Ben Wong and other travelers who send clear details ahead of time usually make check-in easier for everyone.

At the skyport, follow the instructions from ground staff and keep the animal close until you are directed otherwise. If you are traveling with a companion animal like Millie, bring familiar items that help the pet stay comfortable without creating clutter.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the Aurelia Skyways support line.
